cues.text: A golden streak of light arcs away from a lush planet and into the starry dark.
Glowing roots spread across the planet's dark side.
The streak shoots toward a fiery, swirling galaxy.
The glowing lines spread across the fiery galaxy, forming the shape of a colossal, branching tree of light that spans the cosmos.

beats.note: A glowing golden streak arcs from a green and blue planet into space.
Golden light spreads like roots across the surface of the planet.
A massive, swirling, fiery galaxy appears. The golden streak shoots toward it.
The golden streak strikes the galaxy and begins connecting stars with bright lines.
The connected stars form a massive, branching constellation shaped like a tree.
